title: Containable with $hasAndBelongsToMany relationship, using 'fields' key in find.

milestone.description: Bugfixes and optimizations for the 2.4 release branch.

body:
Created by **Heikki Pals**, 2nd Jan 2013. _(originally [Lighthouse ticket #3505](http://cakephp.lighthouseapp.com/projects/42648/tickets/3505))_: --- #### What I did 
// Article.php model
 
class Article extends AppModel {
 
    /**
     * hasAndBelongsToMany associations
     *
     * `@var` array
     */
 
 
    public $hasAndBelongsToMany = array(
       
        'Order' => array(
            'className' => 'Order',
            'joinTable' => 'order_articles',
            'foreignKey' => 'article_id',
            'associationForeignKey' => 'order_id',
            'unique' => 'keepExisting',
            'conditions' => '',
            'fields' => '',
            'order' => array('Order.order_date' => 'asc'),
            'limit' => '',
            'offset' => '',
            'finderQuery' => '',
            'deleteQuery' => '',
            'insertQuery' => ''
        ),
        'SalesOrder' => array(
            'className' => 'Order',
            'joinTable' => 'order_articles',
            'foreignKey' => 'article_id',
            'associationForeignKey' => 'order_id',
            'unique' => 'keepExisting',
            'conditions' => array('SalesOrder.isPurchaseOrder' => 0),
            'fields' => '',
            'order' => array('SalesOrder.order_date' => 'desc'),
            'limit' => '',
            'offset' => '',
            'finderQuery' => '',
            'deleteQuery' => '',
            'insertQuery' => ''
        ),
        
           
    );
 
}

//  containable triggers some errors, when I specify 'fields' key into  'HasAndBelongsTOManyRelation' => array(  'fields' => array( 'col1' , 'col2' ))    
 
// example Article has and belongs to many SalesOrder,  inside controller->view: 
 
$article = $this->Article->find('first', array(
            'conditions' => array($this->Article->alias . '.' . $this->Article->primaryKey => $id,
             
                $this->Article->alias . '.deleted' => 0,
            ),
 
            'contain' => array(
             
                'SalesOrder' => array(
                   
                        'fields' => array(
                                'SalesOrder.id' ,
                                'SalesOrder.client_id' ,
                                'SalesOrder.order_date',  
                                'SalesOrder.isPurchaseOrder',
                                'SalesOrder.account_name' ,
                                'SalesOrder.order_number' ),
                   
                        'limit' => 10,
                        'order' => array('order_number' => 'desc', 'order_date' => 'desc')),
               
             
               
            ),
           
                ));
#### What happened Error messages: ``` Notice (8): Undefined index: SalesOrder [CORE/Cake/Model/Behavior/ContainableBehavior.php, line 159] Warning (4096): Argument 1 passed to ContainableBehavior::fieldDependencies() must be an instance of ``` Model, null given, called in /var/www/html/dev/duell/lib/Cake/Model/Behavior/ContainableBehavior.php on line 159 and defined [CORE/Cake/Model/Behavior/ContainableBehavior.php, line 372] ``` Notice (8): Trying to get property of non-object [CORE/Cake/Model/Behavior/ContainableBehavior.php, line 387] ``` #### What I expected to happen Containable to retrieve correct fields from the relationship and nothing else, no 'link data'. No error messages. Relationship and containable work fine without 'fields' key, but too much data is retrieved.
